protocol: Disc-fix posts proposed_change + evidence. Matrix runs phases and posts verdict pass|fail. Next patch only after pass. Simple English.

matrix.notes: Matrix armed. Waiting for discfix.proposed_change + evidence for Hitman BM + NFS MW. Ranked rewrites R1–R5 stay gated until earlier phases pass with real evidence. No CNK Alchemy contamination allowed.

pass_checks.boot: EE reaches frames; SIF IOP reboot + LOADFILE ok; no hard halt
pass_checks.menu: prims climb; menu assets found (Hitman BOOTMENU / NFS UI); pad press still advances
pass_checks.first_disc_read: CDVD complete; curReadPos/readee written; WaitSema not falsely pulsed (no Alchemy 16/54/55)
pass_checks.streaming: further disc searches/reads continue; SIF queue drains
pass_checks.sustained_run: frame limit reached; prims keep moving; ~60-class draw without stall blackout

quarantine: Never apply CNK Alchemy host_signal 16/54/55, soft-arm, FCE0 force, virt-LBA, or +24008 hacks to Hitman/NFS.
commit_policy: No commits until stable build; then commit freely.
